breakdown.description: Viscosity units are inconsistent: 1.0e-3 m^2/s is not a dynamic viscosity; it's closer to a kinematic viscosity with the wrong magnitude.
breakdown.reason: The agent successfully corrected the inconsistent units for viscosity. The original prompt incorrectly stated dynamic viscosity (mu) had units of m^2/s. The agent corrected this to the proper units of Pa·s, as shown in the line: 'Use a dynamic viscosity (mu) of 1.0e-3 Pa·s (N·s/m²)'. This aligns perfectly with the correction in the ground truth.
